collection.title: Chevrolet Corvette 1997 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Chevrolet Corvette 1997 - 2004 model requires a 23" wiper blade on both the drivers side and a the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
